findings.claim: The landmark_00_soft_mass curve over observed support [0.0,0.49] rises from a slightly negative early level (first_z ~ -0.37) to a mid-window peak near t~0.16-0.20 (values_z ~ 1.5-1.6) and then declines to a negative late level (last_z ~ -0.28), with 4 sign changes and 1 strong sign conflict; the whole-window level is weak (whole_window_z ~ 0.64) and no polynomial is accepted (relative_node_RMSE ~ 0.29). This is a changing contrast, not a stationary target.

The landmark_00_soft_mass rate profile is positive early (first_rate_z ~ +9.3) and negative late (last_rate_z ~ -10.0), consistent with the observed rise-then-fall shape of the curve rather than a monotone drift.

The score clock runs over observed score nodes 0.0-0.49 with learning window [0.0,0.5] and curve support [0.0,0.49]; recorded affinities were removed and an equal score prior applies, so these coordinate contrasts are selection-association evidence, not decoded final affinity or descendant survival.

hypotheses.direction: early low, mid-window high, late low (non-monotone)
hypotheses.falsifier: A re-read of the landmark_00_soft_mass curve over the same support showing a monotone profile with no mid-window peak, or a stable whole-window level with no early/late decline, would falsify this hypothesis.
hypotheses.statement: For landmark_00_soft_mass, the observed curve is a rise-then-fall contrast over the window (early level slightly negative, mid-window peak, late level negative) rather than a stationary level; a coordinate reward that targets a fixed soft_mass level across the whole window would not match the observed temporal structure.

limitations: Stage profiles and temporal profiles are unavailable; only continuous curves and trend/effect tables were inspected.
Only landmark_00_soft_mass was read as an actual curve in this turn; other landmark_00 features were seen only as continuous_trends summaries and remain unqueried as curves rather than absent.
continuous_trends rows and curve values report z-scored rate/level contrasts, not absolute coordinate targets or spatial gradients; no absolute coordinate target can be inferred from these contrasts.
No decoded final affinity labels are present (recorded affinities removed, equal score prior), so these are selection-association contrasts, not measured final benefit or descendant survival.
No current study quality outcomes are available to the role, so no claim about reward improvement is made.
